title: Reschedule by moving the event in your calendar
x:
Drag a meeting to a new time in Google or Outlook, and NeetoCal reschedules the booking to match. Client notified, no second trip into NeetoCal.

Manage your day from the calendar you already have open.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-by-moving-the-event-in-your-calendar
linkedin:
Most hosts live in their calendar, not in their scheduling tool. So when a meeting had to move, the natural thing was to drag the event in Google or Outlook. Then they had to remember to go into NeetoCal and reschedule it there too, or the client would turn up at the old time.

That double entry is gone. Move the event in your connected calendar, and NeetoCal picks up the change and reschedules the booking to match, whether it is a new time or a new duration. The client sees the update, and everything stays in step.

One limit to know about: group meetings are not included. This is for one-on-one style bookings.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-by-moving-the-event-in-your-calendar
slack:
Hi everyone. We noticed that a lot of you reschedule by dragging the event in Google or Outlook, and then had to go back into NeetoCal to do it again there. Twice the work, and easy to forget the second step.

You can now reschedule straight from your connected calendar. Move the event to a new time or change its duration, and NeetoCal reschedules the booking to match and lets the client know.

One thing to note: group meetings are not included, so moving a group session's event leaves the booking as it was. This is for one-on-one style bookings.

Give it a try and tell us how it feels to manage bookings from your calendar.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-by-moving-the-event-in-your-calendar

title: Restore video links after reconnecting video tool
x:
Zoom dropped for an hour and ten bookings got Jitsi links? NeetoCal now fixes them for you.

Reconnect, and every upcoming booking gets your real video link back. No emails to clients, nothing to click, no afternoon of cleanup.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/restore-video-links-after-reconnecting
linkedin:
When your video platform disconnects from NeetoCal, bookings made in the meantime fall back to a Jitsi link so your clients can still reach you. That part always worked. The cleanup did not: after you reconnected Zoom or Meet, those bookings kept their Jitsi link, and you fixed each one by hand.

Now NeetoCal does it for you. The moment you reconnect, every upcoming booking that fell back to Jitsi gets your connected video link back, including bookings created while the platform was down. Calendar events and booking pages are updated, and no extra emails go out to clients.

Fewer broken links, and no afternoon of cleanup.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/restore-video-links-after-reconnecting
slack:
Hi everyone. We heard from hosts whose Zoom or Meet integration dropped for a while, and who then spent an afternoon fixing Jitsi links on every booking that came in while it was down. That cleanup should not have been your job.

Now it is not. When you reconnect your video platform, NeetoCal updates every upcoming booking that fell back to Jitsi during the disconnection with your real video link. Calendar events and booking pages are updated as well. Past bookings and bookings where you chose Jitsi deliberately are left as they are, and no extra emails go out to clients.

If you have had a disconnection recently, reconnect and check your upcoming bookings. Let us know if any link is still wrong.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/restore-video-links-after-reconnecting

title: Control who can change a booking's host
x:
New NeetoCal permission: "Change host for the booking".

Choose which roles can reassign a booking to someone else. Hosts keep managing their own meetings, and nobody hands one off without your say.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/change-host-permission
linkedin:
Until now, anyone in NeetoCal who could manage a booking could also change its host. For a lot of teams that was too broad. You want hosts to manage their own meetings, but not to hand them to a colleague without a word.

There is now a separate permission for it: "Change host for the booking". It applies both to bookings where you are the host and to bookings you made for someone else, so there is no back door.

Turn it on for the roles you trust with reassignment, leave it off for everyone else, and hosts stay focused on their own meetings.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/change-host-permission
slack:
Hi everyone. We noticed that the ability to change a booking's host was bundled into general booking management, which meant anyone who could manage a booking could also reassign it. Some of you wanted that separated.

It now is. A new "Change host for the booking" permission lets you decide which roles can reassign bookings. It covers both bookings where you are the host and bookings you made for someone else, so there is no back door.

Check your roles under permissions and switch it on only for the people who should have it. Tell us if there are other permissions you would like split out the same way.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/change-host-permission

title: Resend and signing notifications for contracts
x:

Resend a contract from the booking when the first email got lost. And a new "Contract signed by both parties" webhook lets your tools start the next step the moment it is signed.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/contract-resend-and-signing-updates
linkedin:
Two changes to contracts, both aimed at the time between "sent" and "signed".

Resend a contract. Clients miss emails, lose them, or ask for a fresh copy. Before, an unsigned contract had no easy way back out the door. Now you resend it right from the booking.

Know when it is signed. A new webhook event, "Contract signed by both parties", fires once host and client have both signed. Until now nothing left NeetoCal at that moment. To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/contract-resend-and-signing-updates

title: Webhook for incomplete bookings
x:
A client starts a booking, then leaves before paying. Your tools used to hear nothing.

NeetoCal's new "Booking incomplete" webhook sends the reason, so you can follow up and recover the booking.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-incomplete-bookings?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webhook-for-incomplete-bookings
linkedin:
A client starts a paid booking. Then they leave before paying. Or their payment is declined. Or someone else takes the slot first.

Until now, your connected tools never heard about any of it. A paid booking only notified your integrations once the payment went through. A booking that stalled along the way stayed invisible to them, so there was nothing you could act on.

We added a new webhook event, "Booking incomplete". It fires for every booking that lands in your Incomplete tab, and the payload tells you the reason.

Now you can follow up on drop-offs, recover lost bookings, and keep your records accurate.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-incomplete-bookings?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webhook-for-incomplete-bookings

title: Webhook for video link or meeting place changes
x:
Your CRM no longer keeps the old video link.

NeetoCal has a new webhook event, "Video link or meeting place changed". It fires with the old and new values, so every connected tool stays in sync and nobody joins the wrong call.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-video-link-or-meeting-place-changes
linkedin:
Here is a gap we closed. When a booking's video link or meeting place changed, the host, the client, and the calendar were all updated. Your webhooks heard nothing, so any CRM or automation downstream kept the old link.

There is now a "Video link or meeting place changed" event. It fires for manual changes, host changes, and regenerated links, and carries the old and new values. The "Host updated" event now includes the video link too.

It arrives switched off, so turn it on from your webhook settings when you want it. Your connected systems stay accurate, and nobody joins the wrong call.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-video-link-or-meeting-place-changes

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Clearer integration disconnection emails
x:
An integration dropped. Which one? What breaks? What now? NeetoCal's disconnection email now answers all three at a glance: what stopped, who connected it, why, and a reconnect button.
To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/clearer-integration-disconnection-emails?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=clearer-integration-disconnection-emails
linkedin:

The email also explains what happens until you reconnect, and what happens after.

One email, and you know exactly where you stand.

NeetoCal no longer asks you to pick a calendar before customizing how meetings look.

Set the meeting name, body and (for Google Calendar) color whenever it suits you. We save the layout and use it as soon as you choose a calendar, for Google Calendar, Outlook and iCloud.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar
